scope: DEVELOPMENT ONLY; source-derived prioritization, not clinical evidence or diagnosis ranking
formula: retrieved + 2*(top150-top25) + active + 4*long_tail_failures + 2*similar + 3*max(0,4-depth_dimensions); dangerous is reported for safety tracking only (no weight)
limitations: Only concepts observed in supplied traces. Depth counts cannot establish clinical quality/provenance; no concept is declared enriched automatically.
